source: Provincial Department of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries, Pursat Province — សារធាតុចិញ្ចឹមសម្រាប់ដំណាំស្រូវ (Nutrients for the Rice Crop), presenter Yem Sophy, 20 Nov 2017, p.11
text: Ideally, soil should already contain all the nutrient elements a crop needs; if it does not, additional fertilizer must be applied to make up the shortfall. For this reason, it is essential for farmers to understand the chemical composition of the fertilizer they use when growing their crop.
